research_orbit: ILLUSTRATIVE circular LEO at 550 km, beta angle varies independently; not a trajectory or annual beta distribution

sources.nasa_2026_power_w_per_kg: https://www.nasa.gov/smallsat-institute/sst-soa/power-subsystems/ : smallsat ROSA table 100 W/kg; NOT 225kW certified array
sources.nasa_2026_launch: https://www.nasa.gov/smallsat-institute/sst-soa/integration-launch-and-deployment/ : dedicated vs rideshare orbital access, separation interfaces and volumes
sources.nasa_2026_iss: https://www.nasa.gov/blogs/spacestation/2026/11/05/spacewalkers-install-final-roll-out-solar-array/ : eight iROSA, 18 spacewalks, generation 160 to 215 kW, NOT extrapolatable labor costs
sources.nasa_avionics: https://www.nasa.gov/smallsat-institute/sst-soa/small-spacecraft-avionics/ : radiation, ECC and fault mitigation not same as commercial GPU reliability
sources.fcc_disposal: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2024-08-09/html/2024-17093.htm : 5-year post-mission disposal requirement where applicable; NOT a maximum operating life
sources.spacex_starship: https://new.spacex.com/vehicles/starship : 100+t fully reusable DESIGN target; not this 550km orbit confirmed payload or firm price
sources.dispatch_cost: USD25m per dedicated flight and 100t to target orbit BOTH speculative and not purchasable contract
sources.partial_failure: 2% per year from earlier R2 what-if; NOT an observed failure rate
sources.orbit_geometry: Analytical circular orbit, spherical Earth cylindrical shadow, beta fixed; no penumbra, oblate earth, ephemerides, comm or assembly
